name: Detective
summary: An arcane investigator who exposes lies, enchantments, hidden creatures, and magical evidence.

features.name: Careful Teamwork +1
features.summary: After three rounds, grant nearby allies bonuses to initiative, Perception, Disable Device, Reflex saves, and AC against traps or while flat-footed for one hour.
features.scaling: +1; increases at 5th level and every 6 levels thereafter

features.name: True Confession
features.summary: After detecting a lie or compulsion, perform to force the target to reveal the truth or the enchantment and grant a new save against it.

features.name: Show Yourselves
features.summary: Compel nearby enemies that fail a Will save to abandon Stealth and remove effects concealing them from you.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.summary: Add half Bard level to Knowledge (local), Perception, Sense Motive, and Diplomacy checks to gather information.

features.name: Arcane Insight
features.summary: Find and disable magical traps and gain +4 against illusions and protections that foil divination or disguise detection.

features.name: Arcane Investigation Spell 1
features.summary: Add one Detective spell-list addition or Bard divination to your spells known as a bonus spell.

features.name: Arcane Investigation Spell 2
features.summary: Add another legal Arcane Investigation spell to your spells known.

features.name: Arcane Investigation Spell 3
features.summary: Add another legal Arcane Investigation spell to your spells known.

features.name: Arcane Investigation Spell 4
features.summary: Add another legal Arcane Investigation spell to your spells known.

features.name: Arcane Investigation Spell 5
features.summary: Add another legal Arcane Investigation spell to your spells known.
